thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from Friday's canary blast — want to capture owners + hard deadlines for remediation items. Short thread so we can assign and move on.

priya: Thanks, can you paste the concrete action list here? I can take ownership of one.

alex: Sure. Summary first: auto-rollback only checked error-rate but the incident was a latency regression. Canary sampled too much traffic (initial pct misconfigured) so blast radius was ~12% instead of intended 5%. Deploy healthcheck and rollout timers also raced with autoscaling.

sam: Yikes. Which telemetry did we miss? p95? tail latencies?

alex: p95 and 99 spikes. Also missing rolling-window aggregation for latency in the canary evaluator. Current evaluator uses instant error-count only.

alex: Action items (brief) — please claim, add ETA in thread, and I’ll put them into the postmortem follow-up doc.

1) Add latency-based auto-rollback condition (p95/p99 + error-rate combined). Owner: priya. ETA: 2025-01-20.
2) Enforce per-rollout initial_pct cap (default 5%) and max_pct gating by service tier. Owner: sam. ETA: 2025-01-15.
3) Integrate canary evaluator with rolling-window stats (300s window) and make it configurable. Owner: maria. ETA: 2025-01-27.
4) Add a rollout "quiesce" timer: pause for Xs after autoscaler events before increasing traffic. Owner: devops. ETA: 2025-01-22.
5) Update runbook with clear steps for latency-only regressions and add a drill. Owner: alex. ETA: 2025-02-03.
6) Incident-pattern detection: weekly job to scan canary regressions and surface recurring patterns to eng-platform. Owner: sam + devops. ETA: 2025-02-10.

priya: I can do #1. Will PR the evaluator change + tests. ETA 2025-01-20 works.

sam: I'll own #2 and help with #6. Will do a patch to default configs and add a safety cap in the rollout service. ETA 2025-01-15 for config; 02-10 for the scan.

maria: Taking #3. Plan: add 5-min rolling window aggregator, expose p95/p99 hooks to the judge. ETA 2025-01-27.

devops: I'll do #4 and coordinate with autoscaling folks. Need to validate on staging; ETA 2025-01-22.

alex: Great. I'll update the postmortem doc and schedule a 30-min follow-up next Tue to review PRs and telemetry dashboards. Also adding a small policy change: any rollout that changes initial_pct must be code-reviewed by a second owner.

oncall-bot: Reminder — weekly canary-regression scan scheduled every Mon 08:00 UTC. First run after changes will be 2025-02-17.

deploy-bot: last canary deploy log: canary-2025-01-03 14:12Z — healthcheck degraded at 14:16Z, autoscale triggered at 14:18Z.

alex: Quick config snippet for the rollout safety we're planning — please review and flag glaring issues:

```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: phased
  initial_pct: 5   # cap enforced
  max_pct: 30
  safety:
    auto_rollback:
      p95_latency_ms: 250
      p99_latency_ms: 500
      error_rate_pct: 1.0
      eval_window_secs: 300
    quiesce_after_autoscale_secs: 60
```

priya: That looks good. Suggest lowering p95 for high-qps endpoints — we should allow service-specific overrides.

sam: Agreed. I'll add tiering: "critical, standard, low" with different caps in my PR.

maria: For tests, I'll add synthetic canary traffic that injects controlled latency so we can validate auto-rollback triggers.

alex: Awesome. Two procedural asks: (A) Everyone drop the PR link in this thread when opened. (B) Owners update the postmortem follow-up checklist with PR, code review owner, and verification steps.

priya: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/rollout-evaluator/pull/482 (WIP, tests in progress)

sam: PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/rollout-config/pull/213 — adding caps + tiering.

maria: PR soon, will post link by EOD.

devops: I'll add the quiesce timer in config and a staging job to validate; posting link when ready.

alex: Scheduling note — follow-up sync Tue 2025-01-09 16:00 UTC (30m). If anyone can't make it, drop status here. We'll only escalate blockers.

sam: On calendar.

priya: On calendar, will demo test run.

maria: On calendar.

devops: Might be out, will post status before the meeting.

alex: Thanks all — feel free to react here with :white_check_mark: when items are PR-reviewed + merged. We'll close the loop in the postmortem doc.

alex: (small reminder) After these land we should run a canary-only chaos experiment that nudges latency to validate the entire chain (evaluator + rollback + traffic shaping). Owner: alex. ETA: 2025-02-14.

priya: :white_check_mark: (will verify after merge)

sam: :thumbsup:

maria: 👍

devops: :ok_hand:

alex: End of thread — will keep updates in the postmortem follow-ups doc and tag here for visibility.
